#BackendEngineering #AdTech #Python #Microservices #Docker #AWS  

Catalina Reyes — Backend Engineer at AdVerve Technologies. Four years of building scalable systems in adtech, where reliability meets creativity.  

I love solving problems that turn data into impact. At AdVerve, I’ve focused on Python-driven microservices that power real-time ad processing. Ownership of a critical API module reduced latency by 25% and improved error handling across campaigns.  

Docker has been a game-changer for consistency, especially when deploying services across AWS. I’ve worked closely with Terraform to automate infrastructure, ensuring our load-balanced setup handles peak traffic smoothly. PostgreSQL and MongoDB are my go-to databases — one for structured analytics, the other for flexible campaign data.  

Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana keeps everything running, and I’ve contributed to optimizing dashboards that help teams track performance.  

When I’m not coding, you’ll find me experimenting with new tools or diving into open-source projects. Let’s build better tech, one line at a time.
